adaptations: Relative imports and explicit grid defaults; numerical MPC, local JPS and dynamics retained. Planner warmup compiles both contiguous and noncontiguous windows before worker readiness.
Upstream robot_jps.py corridor seeding, corridor selection and stop-plan fallback adapted to measured ROS states and persistent parallel workers.
Fixed-altitude 3D flight, Iris physical limits, ROS perception, mapping, formation and supervision retained.
Corridor margin includes occupied-cell quantization and three standard deviations of the configured Gaussian LiDAR noise.
Stop-plan replay follows simulation time and requires measured position, velocity and acceleration agreement; failures remain visible to mission supervision.

2026-10-20: Restored upstream distance-gated per-UAV modes, leader/assignment hysteresis, predictive contraction, path carrots, moving slots, travel-time pursuit and target filter covariance; see docs/DEVELOPMENT.md#verification-and-optimizer-replay.
Coherent elapsed-time/reanchored six-state neighbor snapshots, responsive asynchronous ROS cycles, source-stamped expiry and measured-state fallback validation are intentional physical adaptations.
Runtime CPU/worker caps retained; direct read-only upstream parity uses iteration-only reference settings. Bounded complete optimizer input and backup-warm-start capture added for future replay.

2026-10-29: Solver and predictive dynamics now execute directly from the unchanged pinned submodule. Inactive-neighbor conditioning and optional speed recovery remain in a local adapter; planning, mapping and coordination remain local ports.

2026-11-07: Baseline algorithm 'apf' executes unchanged upstream apf.py (with apfc.py speed_limit and dynamics.py) per UAV through the shared fleet runtime. Local adapters supply measured-state robot shims, latest-scan LiDAR hit obstacles, the upstream leader standoff goal and a one-step command rollout that brakes to rest (upstream impc_ob braking rule).
solver_integration: Unchanged submodule runtime_sources loaded lazily per algorithm by core/upstream.py: mpc_problem.py and dynamics.py for mpc (core/mpc_problem.py applies local compatibility adjustments); apf.py, apfc.py and dynamics.py for apf (core/baselines/ adapters).
